integrity: The proof first establishes directly that strong resolution is equivalent to hitting every deleted matching pair. It then classifies every domination failure among such hitting sets and derives the enumerator by independent per-pair choices minus the exceptional transversals. A standalone checker independently evaluates distances, strong resolution, domination, membership, and coefficients.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected crown graphs Cr_n with n at least three.
The disconnected graph Cr_2 is excluded.
No claim is made for unbalanced complete bipartite graphs with deleted matchings or arbitrary direct products.

Prior direct-product strong-metric theory already implies the precursor classification of strong resolving sets; the assessed contribution is the domination interaction, complete exception list, and all-cardinality enumerator.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= n <= 8 is corroborative only.
title: Strong resolving dominating sets of crown graphs
